About

About Xi Jiade

XJ.

Xi Jiade is a small business promotion and business information consultancy based in Chatswood, New South Wales.

I have long‑term practical experience developing Chinese flour‑based foods and specialty savoury products, including dough wrapper techniques, dumpling formulations and savoury braised food recipes.
This deep industry background supports our work providing promotion planning, advertising ideas and business information for other local small‑business operators.

The founder also has years of hands-on experience with Daoist lijin (traditional manual bodywork) and traditional wellness techniques. This industry experience informs business opening and brand operations advice for Australian wellness operators. This background is used solely to inform business consultancy; the consultancy does not offer these hands-on wellness services or medical care to the public.

These are business consultancy and brand promotion services for other business operators only. We do not directly provide acupuncture, tuina massage, physical therapy, medical diagnosis or treatment. We do not operate a therapy clinic, sell wellness products or medicines, provide practical skills instruction, recruit franchisees or charge franchise fees.

This website is not a restaurant. We do not manufacture, sell or supply any food products through this site. All services offered are business consultancy services for third‑party operators.

Business Notes
02
01 —

Short note: Simple low‑cost promotion ideas for new small local operators

Many new small local businesses in NSW start with very limited marketing budget.
A few practical, low‑cost directions work well:

  1. Clarify who your core customer group is first, before spending on posts.
  2. Build a simple regular social posting rhythm focused on what value you offer.
  3. Run small trial promotions to test response, instead of one big expensive campaign.
  4. Connect with other complementary local small businesses for cross‑referral.

Xi Jiade provides independent promotion planning & advertising concept advice for other small operators.
